visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with tattoos on his arms, wearing a white striped baseball jersey with 'Chinese Taipei' on the front, sits at a white table. Behind him is a dark wall with a neon sign that reads 'Ben's Adventure'. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face and hand gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a montage of ancient Egyptian structures. Massive stone blocks of the Great Pyramid are shown from a low angle, followed by the colossal statues at Abu Simbel with tourists walking in front. The man is then shown in a selfie shot wearing sunglasses and a traditional robe in front of the pyramids. (3) The man returns to the desk, explaining something. Then, detailed visual evidence of the Dendera Temple appears: tall columns covered in intricate carvings and colorful reliefs of ancient figures and symbols. (4) The visuals shift to a promotional graphic for an online course. Three instructors (two women, one man) are shown in a professional setting. Large text overlays 'Maya x Egypt x Shang-Zhou' appear. (5) A sequence follows showing various ancient artifacts: bronze vessels, stone carvings of Maya figures, and a finger scrolling through a book about ancient civilizations. There are also shots of museum displays and close-ups of hieroglyphs. (6) The man is back at the desk, pointing toward the bottom of the screen where a promotional code 'benadventure300' is displayed in white text on a black bar.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male voice speaking quickly and clearly. A bright, upbeat pop BGM with a strong percussive beat and acoustic guitar strums plays in the background at a moderate volume. (2) As the speaker describes his travels, a subtle 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition. The BGM remains consistent in tempo (~108 BPM), maintaining an energetic mood. The environment sounds like clean studio silence under the voice. (3) During the description of ancient civilizations, the vocal tone becomes more narrative and informative while retaining its high arousal. There are no competing background noises, just the stable, rhythmic music bed. (4) The final phase features a call to action where the vocal intensity remains high, ending with a clear articulation of a discount code, as the music reaches its final loop and ends abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Personal Experience -> Educational Value Proposition -> Solution (Course) -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for an online course titled 'The Golden Age of Ancient Human Civilizations,' which covers Maya, Egyptian, and Shang-Zhou history. It uses the creator's personal travel experiences and enthusiasm to hook the audience before introducing the professional instructors and course content.
